purpose: Non-training teardown qualification design; no scientific samples or checkpoint restore.

proof: all ranks observe identical complete receipt set

proof: original traceback/code plus cleanup exception notes
no successful aggregate; preserve controller coscheduling side effects

proof: separate process exit, JAX callback entry/exit and controller outcome

whether JAX world and default hook existed when failure occurred

exact runtime package versions and deployed controller revision
Iris job/task/attempt UID and worker-to-JAX-rank mapping
fresh per-process ONLINE W&B run identity and config before numerical backend use
append-only local event sequence, monotonic time and per-event rank identity
all-attempt native/process/controller outcomes without force completion
independent bounded native history audit of diagnostic sentinel IDs; no scientific training curve reuse

launch_configuration.scheduler_preemption_retry: preserve Iris defaults; no zero-preemption-retry override

retention.constraint: Do not release an accelerator allocation merely because a qualification process ends.
retention.conflict_to_resolve: A holder in the tested task prevents natural task termination; a separate holder has not been shown to retain that exact allocation. Controller natural-exit qualification and allocation retention need independent, source-supported ownership.
required_design: separate allocation ownership from tested child process lifetime
survive injected child failure and successful child exit
obtain explicit consent before voluntary allocation release
retention.source_search_scope: local Iris client/controller source only; no deployed capability inferred

remaining_local_work: Prepare a concrete non-training runtime entrypoint using the optional installer observation seam.
Review expected-failure evidence joins and fresh per-attempt coordinator identity.
Prepare an explicitly CPU-only first qualification scope or resolve accelerator retention ownership.
Publish concrete launch scope before requesting any new-job authorization.

local_trace_contract.scope: Pure-Python actual candidate core, fake coordinator and synthetic traces; no actual ONLINE/controller evidence.

runtime_adapter_design.protocol_stage: Pass TracedCoordinator around the initialized real client into the pure finalization core; wrap shutdown with traced_shutdown. No added coordinator reads or barriers.
runtime_adapter_design.lifecycle_stage_gap: Optional observation is now accepted by the actual installer and pure core. Fake-boundary atexit and persisted trace checks passed. The training wrapper does not yet expose this optional parameter; no runtime qualification entrypoint or launch recipe is supplied.
runtime_adapter_design.forbidden_shortcut: Do not replace JAX global_state.client with a partial proxy or label protocol-only execution as full entrypoint qualification.

evidence_join.source_attestation: Resolved installed module hashes and package/runtime versions must accompany traces.
evidence_join.external_statuses: Join independent native history/state and Iris task/attempt/canonical outcomes using exact cached identity; never infer them from local log strings.
evidence_join.failure_adjudication: A failure trace is not a successful clean trace. Expected injected failure needs separate exact exit/error evidence and canonical failure; missing or killed siblings remain explicit.
evidence_join.clocks: Only compare monotonic time within a process. Cross-host order must derive from rendezvous acknowledgements, not unsynchronized timestamps.

adjudication_contract.clean_pass: Require all exact original task attempts naturally successful, expected rank coverage, source/runtime/controller attestations, clean complete traces and independent native ONLINE finished/sentinel audit. Missing evidence is INCONCLUSIVE; contradictory success evidence is FAIL.
adjudication_contract.injected_failure_pass: PASS means only that the intended failure was detected and propagated. Require an exact injection marker from the intended task/attempt/rank, its original error or exit code, canonical FAILED and every available sibling outcome. Report killed/coscheduled siblings separately; never call this a completed scientific run or claim all peers completed teardown.
adjudication_contract.unrelated_failure: A failure before the intended injection or a failed job without matching injection evidence is INCONCLUSIVE for that scenario; preserve actual execution failure independently.
adjudication_contract.attempts: Record all attempts. Retries receive new native run identity and fresh distributed world; a later pass cannot overwrite an earlier failed attempt. No checkpoint or W&B resume claim.
adjudication_contract.native_identity: Join by exact entity/project/run ID plus execution and per-rank task/attempt identity in native configuration; a URL or display name alone is insufficient.
adjudication_contract.controller_identity: Bind the canonical job record and task attempts to a verified deployed controller revision. Local repository source is not proof of deployed behavior.
adjudication_contract.causality: Use receipt content hashes and protocol rendezvous semantics for cross-host order. Local timestamps alone cannot prove that all remote reads preceded shutdown.
adjudication_contract.history: Use unique diagnostic sentinel IDs with an expected count per rank. Local finish receipts cannot substitute for independent native history evidence; missing/duplicate sentinels remain failures of the diagnostic delivery criterion.

proposed_observation_seam.ownership: Optional explicit observer passed into the actual installer and pure finalization core. Capture the real coordinator and real shutdown callback unchanged; never replace JAX global state.
proposed_observation_seam.event_fields: Per-process sequence, immutable execution/attempt/rank identity, event name, receipt keys and payload hashes, required/application outcome, and error type only. Never serialize arbitrary exception messages, credentials or tracker configuration.
proposed_observation_seam.observer_failure_policy: Latch the first observation failure in memory; stop subsequent observation callbacks. Continue the existing protocol and real shutdown path. If protocol otherwise succeeds, terminate nonzero for missing qualification evidence. If application/protocol already fails, preserve its exception and original nonzero SystemExit code. Persist an error type to stderr only on a best-effort basis; never certify a trace that failed to persist.
proposed_observation_seam.observer_constraints: Synchronous local append only; no network, extra service reads, extra rendezvous or blocking gates. A local write can still block: this seam is not timing-neutral and delayed or blocked filesystem I/O remains a qualification limitation, not justification for a wrapper watchdog.
proposed_observation_seam.registration_failure: Installer registers candidate before removing default; registration failure propagates and leaves old hook intact. Injected registration-failure and subsequent retry checked locally. Arbitrary partial failures within unregister remain unqualified.
proposed_observation_seam.scope_difference: Existing traced_call is fail-fast at trace writes and is suitable only for the archived protocol prototype. Do not install that adapter as the lifecycle observer without implementing and checking the distinct observer-failure policy.
required_local_checks: same coordinator call sequence with observer absent and healthy
observer write failure before receipt publication still reaches the existing shutdown path when peers are healthy and forces nonzero local result
observer failure cannot mask application SystemExit
protocol failure plus observer failure preserves protocol exception
one actual Python atexit subprocess observes replacement hook and natural exit code with fake external boundaries
installer failure preserves default-hook state or documents exact partial registration state
proposed_observation_seam.coverage_limit: A passing fake-boundary lifecycle check still does not exercise real package initialization, JAX service lifetime, native ONLINE delivery or controller aggregation.
